sources.note: Abstract summarises the chapter: 'Tay Tac is basically monosyllabic. It has 22 initial consonants of which 8 can be final & 13 vowels. There are three tones on syllables ending with a stop & six on other syllables.. syllables & syllabic schemes in words'; compared with White, Black and Red Tay. Nothing on stress (the 'stressed & bimoraic' fragment in the same snippet belongs to a neighbouring abstract on German).
